issues.issue: Whether the Appellant had status in Morocco substantially similar to Moroccan nationals (Article 1E exclusion, Shamlou factors)
issues.applicant_position: He had no right to return to Morocco or work in all jobs, so he never had status similar to nationals.
issues.respondent_position: Not stated; the RPD found his Moroccan residence status substantially similar to nationals.
issues.result_quote: the Appellant did not have a right to return to Morocco in a manner that was substantially similar to Moroccan nationals.

issues.issue: Whether, under the Zeng factors, the Appellant should be excluded despite any lost status
issues.applicant_position: Any loss of status was involuntary; return was blocked, Syrian risk and Canada's obligations weigh against exclusion.
issues.result_quote: I further conclude that the Appellant should not be excluded from refugee protection.

issues.issue: Whether the Appellant has a well-founded fear of persecution in Syria as a young Sunni man objecting to conscription
issues.applicant_position: As a Sunni man objecting to Syrian military service, he faces persecution if returned to Syria.
issues.result_quote: I conclude that the Appellant does face a well-founded fear of persecution were he to return to that country.
